title: A change of chapter
description: A directional crossfade connects one small piece of content to the next.
useCase: Move between onboarding steps, short stories or explanatory cards while keeping navigation in place.
reducedMotion: Chapters change immediately without translation or blur; keyboard changes are also immediate.
limitations: Uses three bounded text panels. For longer or focusable content, review height and focus behavior.
look: Warm off-white page with a small soft-orange circle, a dark grey sans-serif headline and paragraph, a hairline rule, a step counter and arrow buttons.
motion: Pressing an arrow slides the outgoing chapter 18 px away while it fades and blurs, as the next enters from the opposite side over 0.24 s with a quick ease-out.
adapt: The transition is the `variants` on `motion.div` inside `AnimatePresence` (`popLayout`), with `custom` carrying `direction`; tune the 18 px offset, `blur(2px)`, 0.24 s duration and ease. Replace `chapters` with your steps, keeping the `canAnimate` gating for reduced motion and keyboard.
